title: The Stories That Create Us #5 - Contemporary Mixed Media Painting in Blue, Orange & Black - With Vivid Contrasting Color & Asemic Writing

said.q: In this work by Laurie Barmore, the artist's hand is exceedingly present. Using strong strokes of black and orange creates its own essences of form atop washes of whites and blue.
